Help/Sending and rendering/Sending

Sending your capture

Send from the app: it uploads in the background. Check your account for rendering status. After the phone check, tap Send to Veylet; sending keeps going even if you leave the app.

  1. Tap Send to Veylet. The first time, the app asks to send you notifications. Allow them to hear when your walkthrough is ready.
  2. The upload uses Wi-Fi or mobile data, whichever the phone has. A whole home is large, so Wi-Fi is quicker and saves your data.
  3. You can leave Veylet: sending continues in the background, even if you close the app. Keeping the phone plugged in helps it finish.
  4. The listing shows Uploading and how much has been sent. Your original capture stays on the iPhone.
  5. When every part has arrived, it moves to Waiting to render by itself.

If it doesn’t work

Sending paused: tap Resume sending. The original is kept on the iPhone.

If the upload window expired before every part arrived, tap Renew expired upload or Retry this job.

You’re offline: the app shows the last status it read and the time. It carries on when you are back online.

To stop, tap Cancel job. Your original capture stays on the iPhone.

Still stuck? Email Veylet support

Write to yoda@yodalai.xyz and a person replies. Say which step you were on, your iPhone or iPad model, and the app version from Account, then About. Never send passwords or sign-in links.
